# Markdown conventions

> [!WARNING]
> Back up the database before you migrate.

> A plain quotation stays a quotation.

The migration changes one setting and adds another.

```ts
const config = {
  retries: 3, // [!code --]
  retries: 5, // [!code ++]
  timeout: 30, // [!code highlight]
};
```

<FileTree>

- src/
  - **migrate.ts** runs the migration
  - …
- package.json

</FileTree>
